name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx as a multisite web server for three virtual hosts, including SSL, security headers, Fail2ban, UFW, sysctl hardening, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, configures Redis authentication and logging, and removes selected replication settings through a post-configuration workaround.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Provisions a Python FastAPI application from GitHub, including Python and PostgreSQL prerequisites, a virtual environment, database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
